name: Curie, Emergent Intelligence
oracle_text:
Whenever Curie deals combat damage to a player, draw cards equal to its base power.
{1}{U}, Exile another nontoken artifact creature you control: Curie becomes a copy of the exiled creature, except it has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw cards equal to its base power."

{1}{U}, Exile another nontoken artifact creature you control: Curie becomes a copy of the exiled creature, except it has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw cards equal to its base power."

needs.what: an activated-ability cost that exiles another permanent you control from the battlefield chosen by selector (here: another nontoken artifact creature you control), binding it with `as` so the effects can read it ("Curie becomes a copy of the exiled creature")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_keys has exile_self (the source only), exile_from_hand and exile_from_graveyard; sacrifice moves the permanent to the graveyard, not exile, and an `exile` op in effects would move the payment to resolution and let the ability be activated with nothing to exile

needs.what: a value reading an object's base power (its printed or copiable power, 208.3 / copy-effect power, ignoring counters, pumps and anthems) for "draw cards equal to its base power"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: value_keys has power_of and power_had, which read current (modified) power; base power is only spelled `power` inside static filters, not as an amount
